description:
PearCal is a peer-to-peer calendar app that syncs directly between devices — no server, no cloud, no accounts required.

Your calendar data never leaves your group. It lives only on the devices of the people you choose to share with, powered by Hypercore Protocol.

FEATURES

Peer Groups

Create a group and invite others via a share link or QR code. Each group has its own color and avatar. Members see only the events shared with them.

Events & Reminders

Create one-time or recurring events. Set a reminder time per event. Selectively share events with specific group members — not everyone in a group has to see every event.

Holidays
Optional US, Canada, and UK public holiday calendars. Toggle per country from your profile. Holiday events are read-only and stored locally only.

Privacy First

No account creation. No email address. No tracking. No ads. Your data stays on your devices.

Open Source
PearCal is free and open source. Source code is available on GitHub.

PERMISSIONS

Camera — used to set your profile photo and scan QR invite codes.
Photo Library — used to set your profile photo.
whatsNew:
## What's Changed

### Bug Fixes

  - **Canadian and UK holidays landed on the wrong dates.** When a holiday fell on
    a weekend, it was being moved to the *Friday before* instead of forward to the
    next free weekday. The most visible symptom: Boxing Day showing on Christmas
    Day. Canadian and UK holidays now follow their own rules rather than the US
    one, so each weekend holiday moves forward to the next weekday nobody else has
    taken.

  - **Two related date problems came out of the same fix.** New Year's Day could
    render as an invalid date in some years, and two holidays could occasionally
    claim the same day. Both are fixed, and the dates were checked against the
    official published lists across 2021 to 2032.

  - **Calendars that already had the wrong dates now fix themselves.** Previously
    you had to switch a holiday calendar off and back on to pick up the
    corrections. PearCal now tidies these up on its own when you open the app.
    Reminders you set on a holiday move with it, and any holiday you deleted on
    purpose stays deleted.
